Name: Alchemy and Potions
Description: Recognize medicines, toxins, and magical reagents, and the history of blending chemistry with arcane principles for potion craft.

Name: Ancient Weapons
Description: Master artifacts of the past, understanding their construction, usage, and legendary histories.

Name: Baking
Description: Prepare breads, pastries, and preserved foods, relying on precise measurements and heat control.

Name: Barsaive History
Description: Recall events, cultures, and key figures of the Barsaive region, enriching contextual awareness.

Name: Botany
Description: Identify and utilize plants for medicine, food, or poisons, tracking growth patterns and habitats.

Name: Court Dancing
Description: The study of refined dances for social intrigue, reflecting etiquette and influence within noble courts.

Name: Creature Lore
Description: Study beasts and monsters, learning their behaviors, weaknesses, and ecological roles.

Name: Discipline Lore
Description: Know the tenets, practices, and histories of disciplined orders, guiding ethical or martial pursuits.

Name: Farming
Description: The history and science of crops and tending livestock, understanding soil health, rotation, and seasonal cycles.

Name: Horror Lore
Description: Comprehend terrifying entities and myths, recognizing signs and strategies for survival.

Name: Legends and Heroes
Description: Recall celebrated tales and heroic deeds, drawing inspiration or cautionary lessons from them.

Name: Military Organizations
Description: Understand the structure, strategies, and histories of armies and militias across regions.

Name: Province History
Description: Explore the chronology and cultural evolution of provinces, linking past events to present politics.

Name: Racial Lore
Description: Study the customs, languages, and traditions of various races, fostering empathy and negotiation.

Name: Scourge History
Description: The study of the Scourge, effective (and in-effective) methods of survival, knowledge of Kaers and their defenses.

Name: Trade Routes
Description: Map key commercial paths, negotiate fair prices, and anticipate hazards in commerce.

Name: Wild Animals
Description: The study of tracks and habits of untamed creatures.

Name: Custom
Description: Work with the GM to create a custom knowledge skill.
